main_body: Flat grass ground strip, with a few darker leaf clumps and three small flowers (yellow, two pink)
top_band: none: a flat ground surface with no standing volume
evidence: Terrain ground tile seen from above. There is no standing body, so the top/front structure contract does not apply. No side faces, no elevation, no plank or slab. Terrain is read as ground, so it is not failed for lacking a top band.

style.evidence: The base is one mid green with sparse single-pixel lighter and darker specks. Large areas of 5x5 px or more are a single flat colour. The few clumps (3-4 greens) and flowers are isolated. The Beodeul grass reference has dense, even tufts and grain across every tile, so most tiles here carry only 2-4 colours against the reference's richer tiles. The candidate looks thinner and flatter next to the reference.
